note.zh-TW: 和銷貨債權增加(-) 是同一科目的兩個方向，累計報表只會用到其中一列（T12）。
note.en: This and the increase line are two directions of the same account; the cumulative statement uses only one of them (T12).

definition.zh-TW: 應收帳款減少表示收回了以前賒銷的貨款，這筆現金不在本期收入裡，所以要加回。
definition.en: A fall in receivables means earlier credit sales have been collected; that cash is not in the period's revenue, so it is added back.
